To [Mary Penelope Fursdon](people/person_539.qmd)

[Mother Goose](organizations/other_104.qmd)'s questions

The religions of the world ancient and modern..

The [illegible] of history and romance[^1]

---

[^1]: Postcard addressed to 'Miss M. Fursdon/Fursdon/Tiverton', postmarked 'Winchester 1 April 1876'.
[^2]: This is an interesting survival which shows the format in which essay questions were circulated to members of the Gosling Society.
